item.title: Agentic QA: AI-Assisted Test Generation and Failure Analysis
item.description:
**Goal:** Reduce manual effort in writing tests, diagnosing failures, and logging defects.

**Approach**

- Playwright with Page Object Model plus an LLM layer for failure analysis.

- MCP-integrated test generation and healing workflow.

- Automated Jira defect logging and Git workflow, configured through environment variables rather than hardcoded values.

- Runs from VS Code and Jenkins.

**Tools:** Playwright, TypeScript, Anthropic SDK / Ollama, MCP, Jira, Jenkins

**What I’d tell other QA leads:** Use AI to draft and triage, and keep a human in the loop for sign-off.

item.title: Automating HTML5 Canvas Games
item.description:
**Problem:** iGaming slot games render on an HTML5 canvas, so there are no DOM elements to locate. Standard Playwright or Selenium locators don’t work.

**My role:** Designed the approach and rebuilt the framework architecture after the first DOM-based attempt failed.

**Approach**

- OCR (Tesseract.js) with image preprocessing (Sharp) to read on-screen values such as balance and win amounts.

- Coordinate-based interaction for spin and bet controls.

- WebSocket interception to validate game-server messages independently of what the screen shows.

item.title: Leading a 16-Member QA Team
item.description:
Context: A QA team serving UK iGaming clients, with coordination between onsite (UK) and offshore (India) teams.

My role: Associate Project Manager, Quality Assurance (2023–2025), after progressing through QA Lead.

What I put in place

  • Test strategy, quality gates and defect management protocols.
  • Resource planning, timelines and performance metrics for the team.
  • Root-cause analysis and data-driven QA reporting.
  • Mentoring and Agile training for junior and offshore testers.

Outcome: Reduced defect leakage by about 25%.

item.title: Playwright + Cucumber BDD Framework
item.description:
**Context:** A reusable end-to-end framework to demonstrate UI and API automation on public practice apps (OrangeHRM and Restful-Booker).

**My role:** Architect and sole developer.

**Approach**

- Playwright + Cucumber.js BDD with a custom World object to share auth tokens across step definitions.

- Excel-driven test data to separate data from logic.

- Resilient locators for complex Vue-based forms (label-relative XPath, custom dropdown handling).

- Jenkins pipeline with published HTML reports.
